For the inclined bar shown, determine the angle $\theta$ and the support reactions.

$$
\sum F_x = 0 = 0.5N_A - N_B
$$

$$
N_B = 0.5N_A
$$

$$
\sum F_y = 0 = N_A - 600 - 1000 + 0.2N_B
$$

$$
N_A = 1454.54\text{ N}
$$

$$
N_B = 727.27\text{ N}
$$

$$
\sum M_A = 0 = -600\times 3\cos\theta - 1000\times 5\cos\theta + 727.27\times 6\sin\theta + 0.2\times 727.27\times 6\cos\theta
$$

$$
\theta = 53.64^\circ
$$

questions.markdown:
For the system of four forces shown, determine the resultant magnitude and direction.

$$
\sum F_x = 70\cos 10^\circ + 60\cos 60^\circ + 30\cos 26.56^\circ - 50\cos 20^\circ
$$

$$
\sum F_x = 78.78\text{ N}
$$

$$
\sum F_y = 70\sin 10^\circ - 60\sin 60^\circ + 30\sin 26.56^\circ + 50\sin 20^\circ
$$

$$
\sum F_y = -9.29\text{ N}
$$

$$
R = \sqrt{78.78^2 + (-9.29)^2}
$$

$$
R = 79.32\text{ N}
$$

$$
\theta = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{9.29}{78.78}\right)
$$

$$
\theta = 6.72^\circ
$$
